# A tiny methods appendix wearing a raincoat

This chapter explains the fake method in plain language.

Raw data live under `data_construction/data/raw/`. The cleaning script writes clean data to `data_construction/data/clean/`. The render script copies the clean data into `book/data/` and then into the Bookdown render wrapper.

The agent instructions are part of the method. They tell agents where to look, what not to touch, and how to report uncertainty. The result is not magic. It is a project layout that makes careful work easier to ask for and easier to review.

The map idea is also part of the method [@agent_maps_2026]. Rendered figure and table numbers can change. Chunk labels and source files are more stable.
